Package jzelda.entities

Class Player

java.lang.Object
jzelda.entities.Entity
jzelda.entities.Player
public class Player extends Entity
Player model object. It stores combat stats, inventory, animation counters and temporary status effects. Input and rendering are handled elsewhere.
